problem.problem:
Bob is kind. Bob is quiet. Bob is white. Charlie is quiet. Erin is furry. Erin is quiet. Erin is white. Fiona is blue. Fiona is furry. Fiona is kind. Fiona is quiet. All kind, rough people are furry. Green, furry people are quiet. If someone is rough then they are kind. If someone is quiet and kind then they are rough. If someone is white then they are quiet. If someone is blue and white then they are kind. If someone is white then they are blue. If Charlie is quiet then Charlie is white.

Determine whether the following statement is true, false, or unknown:
Charlie is furry.
raw_logic_programs:
Predicates:
Kind($x, bool) ::: Is x kind?
Quiet($x, bool) ::: Is x quiet?
White($x, bool) ::: Is x white?
Furry($x, bool) ::: Is x furry?
Green($x, bool) ::: Is x green?
Blue($x, bool) ::: Is x blue?
Rough($x, bool) ::: Is x rough?

Facts:
Kind(Bob, True) ::: Bob is kind.
Quiet(Bob, True) ::: Bob is quiet.
White(Bob, True) ::: Bob is white.
Quiet(Charlie, True) ::: Charlie is quiet.
Furry(Erin, True) ::: Erin is furry.
Quiet(Erin, True) ::: Erin is quiet.
White(Erin, True) ::: Erin is white.
Blue(Fiona, True) ::: Fiona is blue.
Furry(Fiona, True) ::: Fiona is furry.
Kind(Fiona, True) ::: Fiona is kind.
Quiet(Fiona, True) ::: Fiona is quiet.

Rules:
Kind($x, True) && Rough($x, True) >>> Furry($x, True) ::: All kind, rough people are furry.
Green($x, True) && Furry($x, True) >>> Quiet($x, True) ::: Green, furry people are quiet.
Rough($x, True) >>> Kind($x, True) ::: If someone is rough then they are kind.
Quiet($x, True) && Kind($x, True) >>> Rough($x, True) ::: If someone is quiet and kind then they are rough.
White($x, True) >>> Quiet($x, True) ::: If someone is white then they are quiet.
Blue($x, True) && White($x, True) >>> Kind($x, True) ::: If someone is blue and white then they are kind.
White($x, True) >>> Blue($x, True) ::: If someone is white then they are blue.
Quiet(Charlie, True) >>> White(Charlie, True) ::: If Charlie is quiet then Charlie is white.

Query:
Furry(Charlie, True) ::: Charlie is furry.
